segments.ja193:1.1: Ayameva sā ahamapi [ahampi (sī. syā. pī.), ahamsi (ka.)] so anañño, ayameva so hatthacchinno anañño;
segments.ja193:1.3: Yamāha “komārapatī maman”ti, vajjhitthiyo natthi itthīsu saccaṃ.
segments.ja193:2.1: Imañca jammaṃ musalena hantvā, luddaṃ chavaṃ paradārūpaseviṃ;
segments.ja193:2.3: Imissā ca naṃ pāpapatibbatāya, jīvantiyā chindatha kaṇṇanāsanti.
